policy: Discovery reservoirs generate candidates only. A source being approved does not make an item playable. Every item must independently satisfy the curator rights gate with item-level or provider-policy evidence applicable to that work.

sources.name: Blender Studio
sources.rightsExpectation: CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted; preserve attribution and provider terms evidence

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.rightsExpectation: verify the individual file license and attribution requirements

sources.name: Library of Congress National Screening Room
sources.rightsExpectation: inspect the individual item rights/advisory; do not equate availability with public domain

sources.name: NASA Media
sources.rightsExpectation: verify NASA origin and screen for third-party material, marks, endorsements, or other restrictions
